flags.message: Petitioner is represented by the Solicitor General (federal government), but sal-v4 banded the caption 'Warden, Moshannon Valley Correctional Center, et al.' as baseline rather than federal, probably because the facility is contractor-run. Frozen band used as given.

Hold petition: the SG asks the Court to hold pending Montoya Palacios v. Liggins, No. 25-1223 (cert granted 2026-06-29). The outcome here will track that merits decision (GVR vs deny), not ordinary cert-worthiness, so the band base rate is a poor anchor for this cell.
